India and Mauritius Sign Long-Term Fuel Supply Agreement

India and Mauritius have signed a long-term fuel supply agreement aimed at enhancing energy security. The pact designates Indian Oil Corporation (IOC) to meet Mauritius' entire fuel import requirements. The partnership also extends to exploring opportunities in biofuels and clean energy sectors.
